name: MAGNETO
description: MAGNETO is an automated Snakemake workflow dedicated to reconstructing MAGs (Metagenome-Assembled Genomes) from metagenomic data. It includes a fully automated co-assembly step, based on optimal clustering of metagenomic distances, and implements complementary binning strategies to improve the recovery of MAGs

tools.name: snakemake
tools.description: Snakemake is an MIT-licensed workflow management system that aims to reduce the complexity of creating workflows by providing a fast and comfortable execution environment, together with a clean and modern specification language in python style. Snakemake workflows are essentially Python scripts extended by declarative code to define rules. Rules describe how to create output files from input files.

datasets.description: Human Microbiome Project dataset to run the Magneto workflow. A samples.yaml file is also provided. This file should be placed in the config directory of your Magneto working directory. It is used to specify the name of the sample, the run, and its location with its absolute path (that you need to change with the location of your data). This file is currently commented out, so it is up to you to uncomment it according to the files you want to test, one or more of course.
